# Delia Huang — China Inbound Itineraries

> Visa-free-ready China inbound itineraries for international tour operators (B2B).
> Every visa policy claim links to official National Immigration Administration (NIA) of China sources, last verified 2026-10-01.
> Concepts are proposals; ground services, pricing and contracting are provided by licensed Chinese inbound tour operators.

## Pages
- [index.html](https://deliahuang621-png.github.io/china-inbound-tours/): overview, itinerary index, cooperation model
- [visa-free-playbook.html](https://deliahuang621-png.github.io/china-inbound-tours/visa-free-playbook.html): the five visa-free policies relevant to group travel (A: unilateral 30-day waiver, 50 countries; B: 240-hour transit, 57 countries including US/CA/MX, 65 ports; C: Hainan 30-day, 61 countries; F1/F2: HK/Macao group tour → Guangdong/Hainan 6 days, no nationality restriction; G: mutual exemption agreements, 29 countries), with the full 65-port table and official source links. Full country lists are not published on the page — available on request by email.
- [about.html](https://deliahuang621-png.github.io/china-inbound-tours/about.html): who Delia Huang is, what she provides, working principles (B2B only, non-exclusive, no unverified claims)
- [contact.html](https://deliahuang621-png.github.io/china-inbound-tours/contact.html): how to request an itinerary proposal

## Itineraries (rolling out; concept proposals in detail on request via email)
- Hainan "Tech & Rainforest" Journey — 12–14 days, all ages; visa-free for the 61 Hainan-eligible countries including the US; families/adult interest groups as the base product, school study-tour version available
- "Spicy China" Food & Craft Journey — 10–12 days, Sichuan–Chongqing–Yunnan; AU/UK via 30-day waiver, US/CA/MX via 240-hour transit
- Greater Bay Area "Tech Corridor + Engineering Wonders" Journey — 13–14 days, all ages with three visa layers: 30-day waiver (50 countries) → 240-hour transit (57 including US/CA/MX, adult version) → 6-day HK/Macao group policy (no nationality restriction); school study-tour version available
- "China for the Feed" Photo Circuit — 12 days, youth/content-creator segment
- "Roots in Guangdong" Heritage Journey — 8–9 days, overseas Chinese-descent adults, families and student groups; 240-hour visa-free transit (57 countries including US/CA/MX/UK/AU), all-Guangdong permitted area, HK/Macao group policy as backup
- "Cradle of Cantonese Cuisine" — 9–10 days, Guangzhou–Shunde–Chaozhou (Shunde is a UNESCO Creative City of Gastronomy); AU/UK waiver + MY/SG mutual waiver + US/CA/MX 240-hour transit
